name: École Polytechnique
summary: Engineering grande école (l'X) in Palaiseau, south of Paris; one small, maths-heavy English Bachelor of Science with three double majors.

ib.text: Maths HL (preferably AA) and at least one other science at HL. No minimum grades; English C1 by IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 90 or Cambridge 176.

apply.via: Polytechnique's own portal (or Parcoursup, not both)

dates.label: Round 1 closes, 23:59 CEST; interviews in December, results January
Round 2 closes, 23:59 CET; interviews Feb–Mar, results March
Round 3 closes at 2 pm CET (not midnight); results April

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science
programmes.about: A demanding, research-led science degree taught entirely in English: a broad first year, then a double major in Mathematics with Physics, Computer Science or Economics, ending in a research thesis.
programmes.ib: Maths HL (AA preferred) and one other science at HL; English C1 certificate unless exempt. Remote interview in English.

needs.note: The page asks for at least one other science at Higher Level.

programmes.selectionNote: Holistic: grades (above all maths and science), personal statement, CV and two references; shortlisted applicants get a 50-minute remote interview.

notes: You may apply once a year, either here or through Parcoursup, never both; the application fee is €105.
No quotas per round or per nationality, so an early round costs you nothing and gets an answer sooner.
One application also covers the BS/MS track with Columbia University, chosen in the second semester.
